findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_appointment_booking, start_table_booking · Private data: find_appointment_times, find_table_times, start_appointment_booking · Public sink: start_appointment_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_appointment_booking, start_table_booking · Private data: find_appointment_times, find_table_times, start_appointment_booking · Public sink: start_appointment_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool renamed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "book_appointment" was renamed to "start_appointment_booking" (identical description). A rename can slip a tool past name-based review.
